sources.title: Nier Modeler Criticizes Stellar Blade Director Over "Unpleasant" AI Use
sources.snippet: One of these people was Stellar Blade director Hyung-tae Kim, who celebrated the news by posting a seemingly AI-generated image of Evangelion character Asuka surrounded by a bunch of Emil head masks, an image which has become quite iconic for the Nier series thanks to Yoko Taro himself using it to cover his face during public appearances.
